title: trace.x_origin response
description: Trace an X value backward through effective semantic DFS branches to its sources or observability boundaries.
x-description-zh: 从指定信号和时间按有效语义 DFS 多分支追溯 X 的产生位置或不可见边界。
x-output_notes: trace.x_origin 成功响应的 summary 字段为 summary.analysis_complete, summary.chain_count, summary.completed_chain_count, summary.evidence_status, summary.hop_count, summary.limited_chain_count, summary.origin_count, summary.query_time, summary.response_truncated, summary.returned_count, summary.scan_complete, summary.signal, summary.termination, summary.total_count, summary.truncation_scopes, summary.value_width_complete, summary.width_diagnostics；data 字段为 data.chains, data.depth_frontiers, data.limitations, data.query, data.suggested_next_actions。未知字段会被拒绝。完整性和裁剪事实使用 summary.scan_complete, summary.analysis_complete, summary.response_truncated, summary.total_count, summary.returned_count, summary.truncation_scopes。

jsonObject.description: 显式动态键 JSON 对象；每个 value 仍受 jsonValue 递归合同约束。

signal.description: One-bit final waveform signal path used as reset.

polarity.description: Level that asserts reset. X, Z, and unavailable samples are conservatively treated as asserted.

reset.description: Reset definition. Both signal and polarity are required when reset is supplied.
